articles.titleCn: 不要提供无法实现的内容：大规模LLM技能选择中的确定性可执行性门控
articles.abstractCn: 从大型技能库中选择的生产LLM代理面临一个语义相关性无法解决的限制：某个技能可能与用户主题匹配，但在当前账户状态下却无法执行。我们为Helpmate（Wix的客户服务助手）提出了一种部署的三阶段选择流程。首先，一个面向召回的语义匹配器在不参考账户状态的情况下，识别与十种技能领域家族相关的消息。其次，一个确定性可执行性门禁移除满足内部硬停止条件的候选者。由于门禁和技能评估相同的退出谓词，只要谓词一致性得到保持，并且两个检查都基于最新的权威状态，那么被阻止的候选者在相同的账户状态下将无法完成。最后，LLM决定是否调用剩余候选者中的一个。在一个涵盖267.6K对话、756.6K用户消息的上线后生产分析中，语义匹配保留了174,927条消息（23.1%）。在这些匹配流中，门禁移除了1,749,270个技能-消息对中的1,039,462个（59.4%），节省了228.8百万个技能描述标记——占语义匹配后技能描述足迹的59.1%。语义匹配和可执行性门禁共同将技能描述上下文减少了90.5%，相比向每条消息展示所有十种技能而言。为了测试这种剪枝是否影响模型行为而非仅影响上下文大小，我们重放了包含十种技能的1,000个风险增强对话。模型在78个对话（7.8%）中选择了生产阻止的技能。这一反事实结果表明，确定性门禁阻止了不可执行候选者影响模型选择，同时并未声称下游工具执行或客户结果效果。

articles.title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
articles.abstract: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.
articles.titleCn: DeBERTa-Sentinel：迈向透明可信的AI生成文本检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在互联网上的快速传播引发了关于虚假信息、学术诚信、自动化内容操控以及对脆弱在线社区风险的担忧。现有的基于Transformer的检测器，如GPT-Sentinel，虽然显示出潜力，但在泛化到多样化的模型输出和释义攻击方面存在困难，从而限制了它们在构建可信网络生态系统中的作用。这项工作引入了DeBERTa-Sentinel，这是一个利用DeBERTa-v3的解耦注意力机制来捕捉合成内容中微妙结构异常的负责任的AI生成文本检测框架。核心设计原则是透明性：与黑盒商业检测器不同，DeBERTa-Sentinel公开其决策的词级解释，使受影响的利益相关者——记者、教育者和平台信任与安全团队——能够审核、质疑和语境化检测结果。使用包含28,057个人类和LLM生成样本（GPT、LLaMA和Claude）的GLC-AIText数据集（60-20-20分割），DeBERTa-Sentinel实现了98.21%的验证准确率，并超越了NeurIPS 2025的RoBERTa-Sentinel基线，达到97.53%的测试准确率、95.89%的精确率、99.33%的召回率和99.53%的ROC-AUC，同时保持了0.665%的假阴性率。该模型的可解释性揭示了与合成文本相关的语言标记，如学术措辞和正式过渡，直接支持利益相关者对可验证、可审核的内容真实性决策的需求。通过推进减少偏见并增强可解释性的负责任检测方法，DeBERTa-Sentinel促进了可信、合乎道德和以人为本的AI系统。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION获取。

articles.title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
articles.abstract: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs compared to models of a similar scale models. From a 2T tokens candidate corpus, Opt.Gear is trained on a curated 0.5T tokens subset without knowledge distillation. This is the most data-efficient of the existing foundation models. All models are released with open weights and deployment binaries for ONNX, Qualcomm NPU, and Apple ANE making Opt.Gear a practical base for edge applications that need fast, memory-efficient inference and strong task capabilities. Furthermore, to expand the ecosystem of on-device generative language models, we are introducing the Opt.Gear-1M that can be deployed on Micro-Controller Units (MCUs), a Tiny Language Model (TLM). Opt.Gear-1M is the first generative language model to achieve 20 TPS with W4A32 quantization on the ARM Cortex-M7 CPU of the STM32H747I-DISCO.
articles.titleCn: Opt.Gear 技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Opt.Gear，这是一个专为高效设备部署、实时推理和强大任务能力而设计的基座模型。它包含一个密集模型（1M、270M和1B），上下文长度为64K。我们设计了一种新的混合架构，结合卷积键值门控混合器和局部全局注意力机制，以减少键值缓存内存，这种内存往往会随着上下文长度呈指数增长。与规模相似的模型相比，该架构在NPU上实现了高达X4.9的更快预填充和解码速度。从2T token的候选语料库中，Opt.Gear在经过精选的0.5T token子集上进行训练，且无需知识蒸馏。这是现有基座模型中数据效率最高的。所有模型均以开放权重和部署二进制形式发布，支持ONNX、高通NPU和苹果ANE，使Opt.Gear成为需要快速、内存高效推理和强大任务能力的边缘应用的实用基础。此外，为了扩展设备上生成式语言模型的生态系统，我们推出了Opt.Gear-1M，它可以在微控制器单元（MCU）上部署，是一款微型语言模型（TLM）。Opt.Gear-1M是首个在STM32H747I-DISCO的ARM Cortex-M7 CPU上实现W4A32量化20 TPS的生成式语言模型。

articles.title: Can Humans Dream of Electric Sheep? Human-Written Samples for Fine-Grained Vision-and-Language Hallucination Benchmarking
articles.abstract: In an age of rapid model turnover, how do we make hallucination evaluation more perennial? We explore whether human-written hallucination samples could take the place of model-generated hallucinations, in order to make benchmarking detection independent of particular models. To this end, we construct a dataset of 1,600 human-written samples, spanning four languages (Chinese, English, French, Italian), and 18,400 samples from five vision-and-language models, all annotated for hallucinations using a fine-grained span-level labeling scheme. We find that human-written samples result in higher agreement and allow greater control of dataset contents, while remaining distributionally similar to samples derived from vision-and-language samples and providing a reasonable portrayal of detection capabilities - suggesting that human data is a viable substitute for model-based hallucination benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 人类能梦见电子羊吗？人类编写的样本用于细粒度视觉-语言幻觉基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在模型快速更迭的时代，我们如何使幻觉评估更具持久性？我们探讨了人类编写的幻觉样本是否可以替代模型生成的幻觉样本，以使基准检测独立于特定模型。为此，我们构建了一个包含1600个人类编写的样本的数据集，涵盖四种语言（中文、英文、法文、意大利文），以及来自五个视觉语言模型的18400个样本，所有样本均使用细粒度的跨度级标注方案进行幻觉标注。我们发现，人类编写的样本具有更高的协议一致性，并允许对数据集内容进行更大程度的控制，同时与视觉语言模型样本的分布相似，并能合理地反映检测能力——这表明人类数据是模型幻觉基准测试的一个可行替代方案。

articles.title: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
articles.abstract: A language model that abandons a correct medical answer under user pushback is more dangerous than one that was simply wrong, because it lends the credibility of a correct answer to the user's misinformation. Such model behavior, described as medical sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, but we find it is a property of the conversation, not the model. We study medical sycophancy in language models with a fully crossed factorial design over four conversational factors, user role, the evidence behind a false claim, whether the challenge precedes or follows the model's answer, and whether the correct answer is grounded in the prompt, across five open-weight models and 500 MedQuAD questions (1.2M trials). The factors interact sharply: fabricated sources raise sycophancy 2.0x when they accompany the question but halve it once the model has answered, so the same evidence helps or hurts depending only on timing. Sycophancy varies far more across questions than across models (67x vs. 3x), so a single rate reflects the conversation and the questions sampled as much as the model. Chain-of-thought traces explain why. Models that re-examine their own prior answer concede, while those that reason about the medical facts hold, and only a model that has already answered can spend a round auditing the fabricated source.
articles.titleCn: 为什么大型语言模型会妥协：对话因素和导致医疗奉承的推理
articles.abstractCn: 一个在用户反对下放弃正确医疗答案的语言模型比一个简单错误的模型更危险，因为它将正确答案的可信度赋予了用户的错误信息。这种行为被描述为医疗谄媚，通常被报告为每个模型的单一比率，但我们发现它是对话的特性，而非模型的特性。我们通过在四个对话因素（用户角色、错误主张背后的证据、挑战是先于还是后于模型的答案，以及正确答案是否基于提示）上采用完全交叉的因子设计，研究了语言模型中的医疗谄媚现象，涵盖了五个开放权重模型和500个MedQuAD问题（1.2M次试验）。这些因素相互作用显著：虚构来源在伴随问题时使谄媚程度提高2.0倍，但在模型回答后则减半，因此相同的证据是否有助于或损害谄媚，完全取决于时间。谄媚程度在不同问题之间的差异远大于在不同模型之间的差异（67倍对比3倍），因此单一比率反映了对话和所采样的问题，甚至多于模型本身。思维链追踪解释了原因。重新审视先前答案的模型会认错，而那些推理医学事实的模型会坚持己见，只有已经回答的模型才能花费一轮时间审计虚构来源。

articles.title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Preference optimization improves mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but reliable chosen-rejected pairs usually require verified answers, human annotations, or external reward models. We investigate whether preference supervision can instead be derived from the model's internal representation geometry in a semi-supervised setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning trajectories generated across different mathematical problems form structured global point clouds in which correct and incorrect trajectories exhibit different geometric organization. Based on this observation, we propose Cloud--ScPO, a topology-guided preference-mining framework that uses a small labeled set to construct multiple correct and incorrect reference Clouds. Each trajectory is represented by a mean-pooled hidden state and scored against connectivity-induced components using a component-level soft $k$-nearest-neighbor measure averaged across reference banks. We combine this cross-problem Cloud signal with prompt-level self-consistency: self-consistency determines the answer-level preference direction, while Cloud scoring selects concrete trajectories and filters pairs by their score margin. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-Numeric across four model settings show that Cloud--ScPO consistently improves over ScPO, with gains of up to 4.49\% on GSM8K and 4.19\% on MATH-Numeric. Pair-level analyses further show that Cloud--ScPO maintains comparable correctness reliability while more effectively separating informative chosen trajectories from incomplete, repetitive, or otherwise low-quality rejected responses.
articles.titleCn: 云-ScPO：用于大型语言模型推理的半监督偏好优化中的隐藏状态几何
articles.abstractCn: 偏好优化能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）的数学推理能力，但可靠的选-拒对通常需要经过验证的答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型。我们研究了在半监督设置下，是否可以从模型的内部表征几何结构中推导出偏好监督。我们的分析表明，在不同数学问题中生成的推理轨迹形成了结构化的全局点云，其中正确和错误的轨迹表现出不同的几何组织。基于这一观察，我们提出了Cloud--ScPO，这是一个拓扑引导的偏好挖掘框架，它使用一个小型标注集来构建多个正确和错误的参考Cloud。每条轨迹由一个均值池化的隐藏状态表示，并使用跨参考库平均的组件级软$k$近邻度量与连接性诱导的组件进行评分。我们将这种跨问题的Cloud信号与提示级别的自洽性相结合：自洽性决定了答案级别的偏好方向，而Cloud评分则选择具体的轨迹并通过评分差距过滤对。在GSM8K和MATH-Numeric上的四个模型设置实验表明，Cloud--ScPO始终优于ScPO，在GSM8K上提升了高达4.49%，在MATH-Numeric上提升了高达4.19%。对对级别的进一步分析表明，Cloud--ScPO在保持相当正确性可靠性的同时，更有效地将信息丰富的选轨迹与不完整、重复或其他低质量的拒响应分离开来。

articles.title: MedUPS: Towards Diagnostic Assistance in Uncommon Medical Cases with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Uncommon and off-guideline cases are difficult for clinical decision support, because physicians must make a series of management decisions under diagnostic uncertainty and rarely see the full case at once. Most large language model (LLM) benchmarks for medicine score only the final diagnosis, yet much of clinical care turns on the next appropriate action: the next test to order, the imaging study to obtain, the specialist to involve, or the differential to pursue. We introduce MedUPSQA, a dataset of 21,874 mid-stream clinical decision points built from 5,535 real case reports, and MedUPS, an alignment framework that supervises models on these intermediate decisions as they unfold along a patient's trajectory. We segment free-text case presentations into chronologically ordered, accumulating clinical chunks and align models to predict the next step with reinforcement learning (GRPO), using an external LLM-as-a-Judge reward. This objective mirrors how clinicians actually meet patients, reasoning forward from accumulating evidence toward the next decision, rather than committing to a final label. Across three backbones, mid-stream alignment raises next-step accuracy from 55.2 to 66.7 for Qwen3.6-27B, from 47.2 to 57.8 for Qwen3.5-9B, and from 37.8 to 44.4 for HuatuoGPT-3-8B, with 95% CI. In several model scales we test the objective improves accuracy more than scale, with smaller models surpassing larger, frontier models we evaluate. We further train supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on the mid-stream task, SFT improves all backbones above base, indicating the target framwork carries signal independently of the optimizer. We release the dataset, code, and aligned checkpoints.
articles.titleCn: MedUPS：基于大型语言模型的不常见医疗病例诊断辅助研究
articles.abstractCn: 罕见且偏离常规的病例对临床决策支持系统来说具有挑战性，因为医生必须在诊断不确定性下做出一系列管理决策，且很少能一次性看到完整病例。目前大多数用于医学领域的大型语言模型（LLM）基准仅评估最终诊断，然而临床护理的许多环节取决于下一步最合适的行动：需要订购的检查、获取的影像研究、需要参与的专科医生或需要进行的鉴别诊断。我们引入了MedUPSQA数据集，该数据集包含从5,535份真实病例报告中构建的21,874个中段临床决策点，以及MedUPS对齐框架，该框架在患者轨迹中逐步展开的中间决策上监督模型。我们将自由文本病例介绍分割为按时间顺序排列、逐步累积的临床片段，并使用强化学习（GRPO）对模型进行对齐，以预测下一步行动，并使用外部LLM作为裁判的奖励。这一目标反映了临床医生实际接诊患者的推理过程，即从累积的证据中向前推理至下一个决策，而不是直接做出最终标签。在三个不同主干模型上，中段对齐将下一步决策的准确率从55.2提高到66.7（Qwen3.6-27B），从47.2提高到57.8（Qwen3.5-9B），从37.8提高到44.4（HuatuoGPT-3-8B），95%置信区间内。在多个模型规模测试中，该目标比模型规模提升更显著，较小的模型甚至超越了我们所评估的大型前沿模型。我们进一步在中段任务上训练了监督微调（SFT）基线，结果显示SFT提升了所有主干模型的性能，表明该目标框架独立于优化器携带了有效信号。我们发布了数据集、代码和对齐的检查点。

articles.title: Entity-Faithful Repair of Synthetic Supervision for Zero-Shot Image Captioning
articles.abstract: Zero-shot image captioning aims to generate image descriptions without annotated image-text pairs. Recent approaches exploit text-to-image models to synthesize training data from text-only corpora, but most focus on improving overall data quality. In contrast, we observe that synthetic image-text misalignment is often structured and fine-grained: pairs may remain globally plausible while containing missing entities or misgrounded attributes, thereby degrading supervision fidelity. As a result, methods based on global similarity for image rematching or regeneration may improve apparent plausibility, but cannot systematically repair entity-level misalignment. To address this issue, we propose ReCap, a plug-and-play framework that shifts synthetic data refinement from implicit global matching to explicit fine-grained realignment. Specifically, ReCap enforces entity-level correspondence by using detected image-supported entities to guide caption rewriting, yielding more faithful synthetic supervision. In addition, we introduce an adaptive dynamic weighted learning strategy to downweight unreliable synthetic pairs during training. As a general framework, ReCap can be integrated into existing synthetic-data pipelines. Extensive experiments show that ReCap consistently improves image-text consistency and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and cross-domain zero-shot image captioning benchmarks.

articles.titleCn: 合成监督的实体忠实修复为零样本图像描述
articles.abstractCn: 零样本图像描述旨在在没有标注的图像-文本对的情况下生成图像描述。近期方法利用文本到图像模型从纯文本语料库中合成训练数据，但大多集中于提升整体数据质量。相比之下，我们观察到合成图像-文本的错位往往是结构化和细粒度的：即使对保持全局合理性，对中也可能存在缺失实体或错误属性，从而降低监督的保真度。因此，基于全局相似性的图像重新匹配或再生方法可能提高表面合理性，但无法系统修复实体级别的错位。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ReCap，一个即插即用的框架，将合成数据优化从隐式的全局匹配转向显式的细粒度重新对齐。具体而言，ReCap通过使用检测到的图像支持实体来指导文本重写，强制执行实体级别的对应关系，从而产生更可靠的合成监督。此外，我们引入了一种自适应动态加权学习策略，在训练过程中降低不可靠的合成对的权重。作为一个通用框架，ReCap可以集成到现有的合成数据流程中。大量实验表明，ReCap始终如一地提高了图像-文本一致性，并在领域内和跨领域的零样本图像描述基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

articles.title: SCHEDBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Constraint Faithfulness in Natural-Language Combinatorial Scheduling
articles.abstract: This paper introduces SCHEDBench, a natural-language benchmark for evaluating combinatorial scheduling constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation. Grounded in canonical scheduling instances and solver-derived feasibility and optimality, SCHEDBench assesses whether large language models (LLMs) generate schedules with the same constraint-feasible behavior across varied natural-language (NL) surface forms. SCHEDBench spans 1,132 instances across job-shop scheduling problems (JSP), single and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problems (RCPSP), nurse rostering/scheduling, and curriculum timetabling problems of varying difficulty. Instances are templated into natural language problems using domain-specific templates, themed entities, lexical-syntactic template rephrasing, and constraint-level surface-form variation, with reference solutions verified for feasibility and objective optimality. Across thirteen frontier and open-weight LLMs, we find that models are not reliably invariant to semantically equivalent renderings of the same scheduling problem. Surface-form variation reduces feasibility and induces above-noise shifts in per-instance hard-constraint violations on matched instances. Among the tested isolated axes, constraint reordering yields the clearest above-noise sensitivity.
articles.titleCn: SCHEDBench：用于评估自然语言组合调度中大型语言模型约束忠实度的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了SCHEDBench，一个用于评估在表层形式变化下组合式调度约束忠实性的自然语言基准。SCHEDBench基于标准的调度实例以及求解器推导的可行性和最优性，评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在不同自然语言（NL）表层形式下是否生成具有相同约束可行行为的调度。SCHEDBench涵盖了1132个实例，涉及作业车间调度问题（JSP）、单模式和多模式资源受限项目调度问题（RCPSP）、护士排班/调度问题以及难度各异的课程时间表问题。实例通过特定领域的模板、主题实体、词汇句法模板改写以及约束层表层形式变化，被模板化为自然语言问题，参考解经过验证以确保可行性和目标最优性。在十三种前沿和开放权重LLMs的测试中，我们发现模型在调度问题的语义等价表述下并不可靠地保持不变。表层形式变化降低了可行性，并在匹配实例上诱导了超出噪声水平的每个实例硬约束违规变化。在测试的独立维度中，约束重排序产生了最清晰的超出噪声水平的敏感性。

articles.title: Unsupervised Multidomain Approaches to Named Entity Recognition with Small Datasets
articles.abstract: This paper explores the challenges and the methodologies associated with learning quality representations in scenarios with unlabelled small or limited datasets for downstream information extraction task (Multidomain Named Entity Recognition (NER). The study adopts a Transfer Learning on small datasets. Traditional NER systems often rely on large, labelled data, which is impractical for many domains. This study, therefore, applies an unsupervised pre-training approach to precondition and identify entities without annotated datasets, then applies transfer learning models to different simulated limited datasets for a named entity recognition task. Entity Recognition (NER) is essential in natural language processing (NLP), it identifies and classifies related entities within the text. This study addresses the complexities of domain variability, data sparsity, and overfitting and investigates innovative approaches such as data augmentation, few-shot learning, and domain adversarial training. Integrating these techniques promises to enhance the performance and generalizability of NER systems across diverse and resource-constrained domains, paving the way for more efficient and adaptable NLP applications.
articles.titleCn: 基于小数据集的命名实体识别的无监督多领域方法
articles.abstractCn: 本文探讨了在无标签的小规模或有限数据集场景下，为下游信息提取任务（多领域命名实体识别（NER））学习质量表示所面临的挑战和方法。研究采用了小数据集迁移学习。传统的NER系统通常依赖于大量标记数据，这对许多领域来说并不实用。因此，本研究应用无监督预训练方法来预处理和识别未标记数据集中的实体，然后应用迁移学习模型到不同的模拟有限数据集上进行命名实体识别任务。实体识别（NER）在自然语言处理（NLP）中至关重要，它识别并分类文本中的相关实体。本研究解决了领域差异性、数据稀疏性和过拟合的复杂性，并研究了数据增强、小样本学习和领域对抗训练等创新方法。整合这些技术有望提升NER系统在多样化和资源受限领域的性能和泛化能力，为更高效和适应性更强的NLP应用铺平道路。

articles.title: Passing Coarse Marginal Checks Can Be Cheap: Persona Mixtures and Imprecise Treatment-Response Estimates in an LLM Persona Panel
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic research participants and are often validated by whether their marginal responses resemble human data. We study a fixed panel of sixteen lightweight persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 configurations in repeated strategic games. The panel met preregistered broad-reference condition-mean criteria in three of four repeated-game cells; the sole miss was 0.011 below the lower reference bound. Variation was strongly prompt-indexed, but its share depended on uncertainty assumptions: fixed-panel symmetric-Dirichlet sensitivities produced median between-prompt shares of 63%-71% under Jeffreys alpha=0.5 and 47%-53% under alpha=1, while finite-opportunity plug-in estimates were 85%-96%. Aggregate continuation-probability contrasts were +0.083 and +0.078, with conservative simultaneous 95% intervals [-0.171, +0.330] and [-0.181, +0.330]. The treatment jointly changed the continuation process and its textual representation. A separate wording-and-position operation shifted cooperation from 0/40 to 37/40 in the bare configuration, and a label conflict also revealed representation control. The original persona-level p13 result was not prospectively family-controlled, while a post-adjudication exact gate was structurally underpowered; p13 is therefore a replication target rather than a finding. External review exposed family-error, dependence, construct, and boundary-uncertainty defects, and zero-call reanalysis changed the interpretation without rewriting the historical record. The registered marginal criteria could be passed without precisely estimating the treatment-response object. A public capsule verifies 4,916 confirmatory Phase 3-5 runs with no live model calls. The results concern one fixed model-prompt panel and do not establish human substitutability.

articles.titleCn: 通过粗略边际检查的成本可能较低：在LLM角色面板中的人设混合与不精确的处理-反应估计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作合成研究参与者，并且它们的有效性通常通过其边际响应是否类似于人类数据来验证。我们研究了一组固定的十六个轻量级角色条件GPT-4.1配置在重复策略游戏中的表现。该小组在四个重复游戏单元中的三个满足了预先注册的广泛参考条件均值标准；唯一未达标的是0.011低于下限参考值。变化强烈依赖于提示索引，但其份额取决于不确定性假设：固定小组对称-Dirichlet敏感性在Jeffreys alpha=0.5时产生了63%-71%的中位数提示间份额，在alpha=1时为47%-53%，而有限机会插值估计为85%-96%。总体延续概率对比为+0.083和+0.078，保守的同时95%区间为[-0.171, +0.330]和[-0.181, +0.330]。该处理同时改变了延续过程及其文本表示。一个单独的措辞和位置操作将合作从0/40变为37/40，标签冲突也揭示了表示控制。原始角色级别的p13结果未能前瞻性家族控制，而事后裁决的精确门限在结构上效力不足；因此p13是一个重复验证目标而非发现。外部审查暴露了家族误差、依赖性、结构以及边界不确定性缺陷，而零调用重新分析改变了解释而没有重写历史记录。注册的边际标准可以在不精确估计处理响应对象的情况下通过。一个公共胶囊验证了4,916次确认性第三至五阶段运行，且无实时模型调用。结果涉及一个固定的模型-提示小组，并未确立人类替代性。

articles.title: Mind the Gap: Zero-Query Jailbreaks via Filter-Generator Discrepancy in Text-to-Image Systems
articles.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) systems typically have prompt-level safety filters before the generator to block unsafe requests, yet such systems remain vulnerable to malicious jailbreak prompts. Transfer-based attacks construct adversarial prompts offline without querying the target, but they tend to overfit to a single surrogate. Moreover, they explore a large search space in which semantic or perceptual similarity alone cannot guarantee both filter evasion and preservation of the unsafe generation intent, wasting effort on low-potential candidates. We observe that the filter and the generator process the same prompt under different objectives and representations, and term this gap the Filter-Generator Discrepancy (FGD), which allows a perturbation to reduce a prompt's perceived risk to the filter while preserving the visual concept needed by the generator. Building on FGD, we propose a zero-query jailbreak framework that screens perturbations into a high-potential candidate set via observable discrepancy rules at the tokenization and semantic stages, and then performs a surrogate-ensemble evolutionary search that requires no access to the target. Experiments on six black-box pipelines and a commercial online service show that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, raising the average attack success rate to 29.2\% (MHSC) and 33.3\% (Q16) across the six pipelines and improving over the strongest baseline by about 8 and 12 percentage points, respectively.
articles.titleCn: 注意差距：基于过滤器生成器差异的无查询越狱技术在文本到图像系统中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 文本到图像（T2I）系统通常在生成器之前设置提示级别的安全过滤器来阻止不安全的请求，但这些系统仍然容易受到恶意越狱提示的攻击。迁移式攻击可以在不查询目标的情况下离线构建对抗性提示，但它们往往过度拟合到单个替代品。此外，它们探索一个很大的搜索空间，其中语义或感知相似性并不能保证同时绕过过滤器和保留不安全生成意图，从而浪费了在低潜力候选上的精力。我们观察到，过滤器和生成器在不同的目标和表示下处理相同的提示，我们将这种差异称为过滤器-生成器差异（FGD），它允许扰动减少提示对过滤器的感知风险，同时保留生成器所需的视觉概念。基于FGD，我们提出了一种零查询越狱框架，该框架通过在标记化和语义阶段使用可观察的差异规则筛选扰动到高潜力候选集，然后执行无需访问目标的替代器集成进化搜索。在六个黑盒流程和一个商业在线服务上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于代表性基线，在六个流程中平均攻击成功率提高到29.2%（MHSC）和33.3%（Q16），分别比最强的基线提高了约8和12个百分点。

articles.title: Gaokerena: A Small Persian Medical Language Model Family
articles.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into medical question-answering systems has advanced rapidly; however, research remains predominantly focused on English, leaving low resource languages like Persian significantly underserved. To address this gap, this paper introduces Gaokerena, a novel family of compact Persian medical language models optimized for deployment on consumer grade hardware. As a foundational step toward localized digital healthcare, we first present Gaokerena-V, developed by training a baseline model on a newly curated 90-million-token Persian medical corpus and 20,000 expert-vetted physician Q&A pairs, which improved performance on a translated medical MMLU benchmark from 46.28% to 49.31%. Second, recognizing the critical demands of clinical reasoning, we developed Gaokerena-R by integrating a Chain-of-Thought approach with two novel Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF) frameworks to optimize preference-based reasoning. Despite utilizing the same baseline architecture and a smaller dataset than Gaokerena-V, Gaokerena-R achieved a superior benchmark score of 52.98%. Furthermore, both models are equipped with custom-developed uncertainty heads that predict the model's confidence in its responses based solely on internal hidden states. While these results demonstrate significant progress in Persian medical language modeling and proactive safety estimation, current performance levels remain insufficient for direct clinical application, highlighting the necessity for further research into robust knowledge acquisition and rigorous safety verification prior to real world deployment.
articles.titleCn: 高克伦娜：一个小型波斯医学语言模型家族
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能在医疗问答系统中的集成发展迅速；然而，研究仍主要集中于英语，导致像波斯语这样的低资源语言服务严重不足。为填补这一空白，本文介绍了Gaokerena，一个专为消费级硬件部署而优化的紧凑型波斯语医疗语言模型家族。作为本地化数字医疗的基础性步骤，我们首先介绍了Gaokerena-V，该模型通过在新构建的9000万token波斯语医疗语料库和20000对专家审核的医师问答对上训练基线模型开发而成，将翻译后的医疗MMLU基准测试性能从46.28%提升至49.31%。其次，鉴于临床推理的迫切需求，我们通过整合思维链方法与两种新型人工智能反馈强化学习（RLAIF）框架开发了Gaokerena-R，以优化基于偏好的推理。尽管Gaokerena-R使用相同的基线架构且数据集规模小于Gaokerena-V，但其实现了52.98%的优异基准分数。此外，这两个模型都配备了定制开发的不确定性头，仅基于内部隐藏状态预测模型对其回答的置信度。虽然这些结果展示了波斯语医疗语言建模和主动安全评估方面的显著进步，但当前性能水平仍不足以直接用于临床应用，凸显了在真实世界部署前，进一步研究稳健知识获取和严格安全验证的必要性。

articles.title: FinHardBench: Can LLMs Generate Latency-Aware Hardware for Financial Computing?

authors.name: Hejia Zhang
authors.affiliation: 5/5 seeds vs. 0-4/5 at the same 24-round budget

articles.abstract: Can large language models generate not just correct, but fast hardware? This paper investigates the question in financial FPGA design, where 5-10 nanoseconds of latency determines competitive advantage and designs iterate continuously as protocols, strategies, and regulations evolve. FinHardBench, a benchmark of 33 financial computing tasks, is presented together with three experiments that mirror the real-world FPGA iteration cycle: generating new modules from specifications, tuning system-level configurations across a 6-stage trading pipeline, and adapting existing modules to specification changes. Evaluation of six LLMs on 1530+ experiment rounds yields three findings: (1) models achieve 19-61% functional correctness with timing degradation up to 13.7$\times$ on specific tasks; (2) in system-level design space exploration, top LLMs converge to the optimal configuration with higher reliability than random search, simulated annealing, and Bayesian optimization baselines (5/5 seeds vs. 0-4/5 at the same 24-round budget); (3) strategy-level specification changes remain unsolved for most models. Across the six models, generation and DSE rankings overlap moderately: the strongest code generator is not the fastest architecture optimizer, and the weakest code generator (MiniMax M2.7) still reaches the system optimum on 4 of 5 seeds. On the tasks in FinHardBench, difficulty tracks training data pattern availability more closely than abstraction level. FinHardBench is released as an open-source benchmark.
articles.comment: 16 pages (10 pages main text). Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/owenfucell/FinHardBench
articles.titleCn: FinHardBench：大型语言模型能否生成适用于金融计算的延迟感知硬件？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能否不仅生成正确的，而且生成高效的硬件？本文在金融FPGA设计领域探讨了这一问题，其中5-10纳秒的延迟决定了竞争优势，且随着协议、策略和法规的演变，设计持续迭代。本文提出了FinHardBench，一个包含33项金融计算任务的基准，并设计了三个实验模拟现实世界FPGA迭代周期：根据规范生成新模块、在6阶段交易流水线中调整系统级配置、以及根据规范变化调整现有模块。对六个LLM在1530多次实验轮次中的评估得出三个发现：(1) 模型在特定任务上实现了19-61%的功能正确性，时序性能下降高达13.7倍；(2) 在系统级设计空间探索中，顶尖LLM以比随机搜索、模拟退火和贝叶斯优化基线更高的可靠性收敛到最优配置（5/5种子 vs. 同样的24轮预算下的0-4/5）；(3) 大多数模型在策略级规范变化上仍存在未解决的问题。在六个模型中，生成和DSE排名中度度重叠：最强的代码生成器并非最快的架构优化器，最弱的代码生成器（MiniMax M2.7）在5个种子中的4个上仍达到系统最优。在FinHardBench任务中，难度与训练数据模式可用性比抽象级别更紧密相关。FinHardBench作为开源基准发布。

articles.title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
articles.abstract: LLM agents accumulate long trajectories of reasoning steps, tool calls, and environment feedback, making the KV cache a major inference bottleneck. KV cache compaction can reduce this cost, but most prior methods assume a static context where future queries are known or can be approximated offline. Agents instead require online compaction: new information must be compressed before future relevance is known, using proxy queries cheap enough for the inference path. We study online compaction across token eviction (TE) and attention matching (AM), adapting both to compact agent turns and comparing cheap proxy sources such as boundary, repeat-prefill, and delayed future-generation queries. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and WideSearch show that immediate compaction often hurts performance, whereas delaying compaction to use the agent's future queries recovers much of the gap. Moreover, TE is often more robust than AM under imperfect proxies. Across models at different scales, TE preserves most of the accuracy while reducing KV cache by 80%, and can improve throughput over the no compaction baseline. These results position proxy-query selection as a core design choice for practical online KV compaction.
articles.titleCn: 面向大语言模型代理的实用在线键值缓存压缩：实证研究
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理会积累大量的推理步骤、工具调用和环境反馈轨迹，使得KV缓存成为主要的推理瓶颈。KV缓存压缩可以降低这种成本，但大多数先前方法假设一个静态环境，其中未来的查询已知或可以离线近似。相反，代理需要在线压缩：新信息必须在未来的相关性已知之前被压缩，使用足够便宜以供推理路径使用的代理查询。我们研究了在线压缩的两种方法：令牌驱逐（TE）和注意力匹配（AM），将两者都调整为压缩代理的回合，并比较廉价的代理源，如边界、重复预填充和延迟的未来生成查询。在BrowseComp-Plus和WideSearch上的实验表明，立即压缩通常会损害性能，而将压缩延迟到使用代理的未来查询可以弥补大部分差距。此外，在代理查询不完美的情况下，TE通常比AM更稳健。在不同规模的模型中，TE在减少80%的KV缓存的同时保留了大部分的准确性，并且可以比无压缩基线提高吞吐量。这些结果将代理查询选择定位为实际在线KV压缩的核心设计选择。
